scenario: 面试官给你一道语义搜索(semantic search)设计题,你有 45 分钟,正准备开场。
scenario_en: An interviewer gives you a semantic search design question with 45 minutes, and you are about to open.
q: 开场该先讲数据策略还是先画双塔架构图?为什么?
q_en: Should you open with data strategy or with a two-tower architecture diagram, and why?
why: 语义搜索的质量上限由训练数据决定,不是模型架构;所以先讲 relevance pair 怎么从用户信号构造,再谈模型。反过来先画架构,面试官会觉得你没意识到数据才是天花板。
why_en: The quality ceiling of semantic search is set by the training data, not the architecture, so lead with how relevance pairs are built from user signals before drawing any model.
tradeoff: 先数据策略(点住真正的天花板) vs 先画架构(容易被追问数据从哪来而卡壳)
whenOtherWins: 如果题目明确聚焦模型结构(如「设计 cross-encoder 重排层」)或数据管线已给定,才可以直接从架构讲起。
diagram:
flowchart TD D["数据策略
质量天花板"] --> P1["relevance pair
用户信号构造"] D --> P2["query 预处理
拼写纠错 + 改写"] D --> P3["双塔训练数据
正例 + 负例分层"]
options: 先画双塔 / cross-encoder 架构图,模型选型才是质量上限,数据是次要细节
先选向量库和 ANN 索引,检索基础设施才是决定质量的瓶颈所在
先讲数据策略:relevance pair 怎么从用户信号造出来,数据质量才是天花板
先定 embedding 维度、batch size 等超参,调参决定了最终召回上限
options_en: Draw the two-tower / cross-encoder architecture first — model choice is the quality ceiling and data is a minor detail.
Pick the vector store and ANN index first — retrieval infrastructure is the bottleneck that decides quality.
Lead with data strategy: how relevance pairs are built from user signals, since data quality is the ceiling.
Fix embedding dimension, batch size, and other hyperparameters first — tuning decides the recall ceiling.
optionExplanations: 架构再漂亮,喂进去的 relevance pair 有噪声,模型学到的就是噪声——数据在前、架构在后。
向量库和 ANN 是工程承载,不产生监督信号;它们解决「查得快」,不解决「学得准」。
对;先钉住数据从哪来、怎么去噪,后面架构选型才有意义,这是面试官想听的顺序。
超参是最后的边际优化,数据管线不对,调再多参也顶不破数据设定的天花板。
optionExplanations_en: A great architecture fed noisy relevance pairs just learns the noise — data comes before architecture.
Vector store and ANN are engineering carriers producing no supervision; they make search fast, not accurate.
Correct — pin down where data comes from and how it is denoised first, then architecture choices matter, which is what interviewers want to hear.
Hyperparameters are the final marginal tuning; if the data pipeline is wrong, no tuning breaks the data-set ceiling.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按语义相似度而非关键词精确匹配来检索文档的搜索系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Semantic search retrieves documents by meaning similarity rather than exact keyword match.

termDefinitions.meaning: (query, doc) 加上「相关/不相关」标签,是训练检索模型的监督样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A relevance pair is a (query, doc) with a relevant/not-relevant label, the supervision for training retrieval models.

termDefinitions.meaning: query 和 doc 各用一个编码器映射成向量,按向量相似度检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dual-encoder (two-tower) model encodes query and doc separately into vectors and retrieves by vector similarity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索:在向量空间里快速找相似向量,牺牲一点精度换速度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) quickly finds similar vectors in embedding space, trading a little accuracy for speed.

scenario: 双塔模型从 (query, doc) relevance pair 学习,这些 pair 要从真实数据里造出来,而不是凭空标注。
scenario_en: A dual-encoder learns from (query, doc) relevance pairs that must be constructed from real data, not labeled from scratch.
q: 构造 query-doc relevance pair 的三大信号来源是什么?
q_en: What are the three signal sources for constructing query-doc relevance pairs?
why: 三来源:隐式点击日志(海量但噪声大)、隐式停留时长(区分满意/不满意点击)、显式人工打分(0-4,干净但稀缺)。前两者撑规模训练,后者做可信评估。
why_en: Three sources: implicit click logs (abundant, noisy), implicit dwell time (separates satisfied clicks), and explicit human labels (0-4, clean but scarce).
options: 点击日志(隐式)、停留时长(隐式)、人工相关性打分(显式),三种互补的信号
只有人工标注一种来源是可靠的,点击和停留噪声太大应全部弃用
随机采样 (query, doc) 对,靠模型自监督推断相关性,不需要任何用户信号
直接爬网页的 title-body 对当正例,不看用户在搜索里的真实行为
options_en: Click logs (implicit), dwell time (implicit), and human relevance labels (explicit) — three complementary signals.
Only human labels are reliable; clicks and dwell are too noisy and should be dropped entirely.
Randomly sample (query, doc) pairs and let the model self-supervise relevance, needing no user signal.
Scrape web title-body pairs as positives, ignoring real user behavior in search.
optionExplanations: 对;三者互补——点击给规模、停留去噪、人工分做可信基准,数据策略就是编排这三者。
只用人工标注量太少、覆盖不了长尾,放弃隐式信号等于放弃规模训练。
自监督没有真实相关性锚点,造出来的正例可能根本不相关,喂出噪声模型。
title-body 是文档内部结构,不反映用户搜什么、点什么,不是相关性信号。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the three are complementary: clicks give scale, dwell denoises, human labels give a trusted baseline; data strategy orchestrates all three.
Human labels alone are too few to cover the long tail; dropping implicit signals gives up scale training.
Self-supervision has no real relevance anchor, so its positives may be irrelevant and train a noisy model.
Title-body is document-internal structure, not what users search or click, so it is not a relevance signal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录用户对每个 query 点了哪些结果的日志,是最海量的隐式相关性信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A click log records which results a user clicked for each query, the most abundant implicit relevance signal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户点开一个结果后停留阅读的时长,用来区分满意点击和误点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dwell time is how long a user stays on a clicked result, used to tell satisfied clicks from accidental ones.

termDefinitions.term: explicit relevance label / 显式相关性标注
termDefinitions.meaning: 人工评审员给 (query, doc) 打的分级相关性(如 0-4),干净但昂贵。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An explicit relevance label is a human rater's graded score (e.g. 0-4) for a (query, doc), clean but costly.

scenario: 点击日志里排在第 1 位的结果点击量远高于第 5 位,哪怕两者真实相关性其实差不多。
scenario_en: In click logs, the rank-1 result gets far more clicks than rank-5 even when their true relevance is similar.
q: 点击日志的 position bias 是什么,怎么纠正?
q_en: What is position bias in click logs, and how do you correct it?
why: 高位置纯因为曝光靠前被多点,不代表更相关(position bias);用 inverse propensity weighting 按每个位置的曝光倾向反向加权,把位置带来的虚高点击压回真实相关信号。代价:要可靠估计各位置 propensity。
why_en: Top ranks get more clicks just from exposure, not relevance (position bias); inverse propensity weighting down-weights clicks by each position's exposure propensity to recover the true signal.
diagram:
flowchart LR C["原始点击"] --> B["position bias
高位虚高"] B --> W["IPW 反向加权
÷ 曝光倾向"] W --> S["去偏 relevance 信号"]
options: position bias 是模型在训练集上过拟合,加 dropout 和权重衰减即可消除
高位置点击多,是因为排在前面的结果本来就更相关,属于真信号不必纠正
直接删掉排名前三位的所有点击样本,只留低位点击来训练模型
高位曝光抬高了点击(非真相关),用 inverse propensity weighting 按曝光倾向反向加权
options_en: Position bias is overfitting on the training set, removable with dropout and weight decay.
Top ranks get more clicks because those results are genuinely more relevant, a true signal needing no correction.
Just delete all clicks from the top three ranks and train only on low-rank clicks.
High-rank exposure inflates clicks (not true relevance), so down-weight by exposure propensity via inverse propensity weighting.
optionExplanations: position bias 是数据采集偏差,不是模型过拟合;正则改的是模型,救不了有偏的标签。
因果说反了:排前面才被多点,不是被多点才排前面,这正是要纠正的混淆。
删掉高位点击把最有信息量的正例也扔了,而且低位点击更稀疏、噪声更大。
对;IPW 用各位置的曝光倾向(propensity)反向加权,把「因位置而虚高」的点击折算回真实相关度。
optionExplanations_en: Position bias is a data-collection bias, not model overfitting; regularization changes the model, not the biased labels.
The causality is reversed: ranking high causes more clicks, not the other way, which is exactly the confound to correct.
Deleting top-rank clicks throws away the most informative positives, and low-rank clicks are sparser and noisier.
Correct — IPW down-weights clicks by each position's exposure propensity, converting position-inflated clicks back to true relevance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结果排得越靠前越易被点击,与真实相关性无关的系统性偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Position bias is the systematic tendency for higher-ranked results to get more clicks regardless of true relevance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 逆倾向加权:用样本被曝光/观测的概率的倒数加权,抵消采集偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IPW (Inverse Propensity Weighting) weights each sample by the inverse of its exposure probability to cancel collection bias.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个结果在某位置被用户看到的概率,IPW 用它做反向加权。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Propensity is the probability a result at a given position is seen by the user, used by IPW for down-weighting.

scenario: 点击本身分不清用户是否满意:点开 2 秒就跳走 vs 点开读了 60 秒,是完全不同的信号。
scenario_en: A click alone cannot tell satisfaction: a 2-second bounce versus a 60-second read are very different signals.
q: 停留时长常用多少秒做「满意 vs 不满意」的二值化阈值?
q_en: What dwell-time threshold is commonly used to binarize satisfied vs unsatisfied clicks?
why: 约 30 秒是经验阈值(来自内容型场景的行业实践),不是公式推导;它把连续的 dwell time 二值化成满意/不满意标签,下游用来过滤短停留的误点、只留高质量正例。阈值随内容类型可调:新闻文章约 30 秒、商品列表约 10 秒。
why_en: About 30 seconds is an empirical threshold, not a derived formula, that binarizes continuous dwell time into satisfied/unsatisfied labels to filter accidental clicks and keep high-quality positives.
options: 约 30 秒:超过算满意点击(相关),几秒就跳出算不满意,用来过滤误点
约 0.5 秒:只要页面加载完就算满意,不看用户是否真的读了内容
约 10 分钟:必须读满十分钟才算相关,否则一律判为负例样本
不设阈值:所有点击一律当满意正例,dwell time 完全不参与判定
options_en: About 30 seconds: above it is a satisfied (relevant) click, a few-second bounce is unsatisfied, filtering accidental clicks.
About 0.5 seconds: as soon as the page loads it counts as satisfied, regardless of actual reading.
About 10 minutes: only a full ten-minute read counts as relevant, else it is a negative.
No threshold: every click is a satisfied positive and dwell time plays no role.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户点开结果后停留的时长,约 30 秒常作满意/不满意的二值化阈值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dwell time is time spent on a clicked result; ~30s is a common satisfied/unsatisfied binarization threshold.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户点开发现不对就立刻跳走的点击,dwell 过滤要剔除的噪声。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An accidental click is one where the user immediately bounces, the noise dwell filtering removes.

scenario: 你的搜索同时索引新闻文章和电商商品列表,现在用一个固定 30 秒 dwell 阈值判断满意点击。
scenario_en: Your search indexes both news articles and e-commerce listings, using one fixed 30-second dwell threshold for satisfied clicks.
q: 该给所有内容类型用同一个 dwell 阈值吗?
q_en: Should you use the same dwell threshold across all content types?
why: 消费一条内容所需时间随类型差别大——读新闻要几十秒,扫一眼商品几秒就够。固定阈值会把「快速满意」的商品点击误判成不满意,所以按内容类型分别定阈值。
why_en: Time to consume content varies by type — reading news takes tens of seconds, scanning a product takes a few — so a fixed threshold misjudges quick satisfied clicks and thresholds should be per content type.
tradeoff: 按类型分别调阈值(贴合真实满意,多一套配置) vs 统一阈值(简单,误判快消费内容)
whenOtherWins: 如果平台只有单一内容类型(如纯新闻站),用一个统一阈值就够,没必要按类型区分。
options: 用统一 30 秒阈值最省事,内容类型不影响判断满意所需的停留时间
按内容类型调:新闻文章约 30 秒、商品列表约 10 秒(有加购信号更短)
阈值越高越干净,统一设成 5 分钟保证只留下最相关的正例样本
干脆不看 dwell time,只要有点击就一律算作满意的正例来训练
options_en: A uniform 30-second threshold is simplest; content type does not affect the time needed to feel satisfied.
Tune per content type: news ~30s, product listings ~10s (shorter with add-to-cart signals).
The higher the better — set a uniform 5 minutes so only the most relevant positives remain.
Skip dwell time entirely and count every click as a satisfied positive for training.
optionExplanations: 统一阈值把「几秒扫完就满意」的商品点击误杀成不满意,系统性丢失电商正例。
对;不同内容的满意时长不同,分类型定阈值才能把快消费内容的满意点击正确保留。
5 分钟过严,连正常读完新闻的用户都被判不满意,正例几乎全被过滤光。
不看 dwell 就退回原始点击,误点和 position bias 全灌进正例,失去过滤意义。
optionExplanations_en: A uniform threshold kills quick-scan product clicks as unsatisfied, systematically losing e-commerce positives.
Correct — satisfaction time differs by content, so per-type thresholds correctly keep quick-consumption satisfied clicks.
Five minutes is too strict; even normal news readers are judged unsatisfied and nearly all positives are filtered out.
Skipping dwell reverts to raw clicks, pouring accidental clicks and position bias into positives and losing the filter's point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 判定满意点击的停留时间界限,应按内容类型(新闻 vs 商品)分别设定。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dwell threshold is the stay-time cutoff for a satisfied click, set per content type (news vs product).

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户把商品加入购物车的动作,是比停留更强的满意信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Add-to-cart is a user placing an item in the cart, a stronger satisfaction signal than dwell.

scenario: 电商/招聘/社交搜索里,除了点击还有加购(add-to-cart)、投递(apply)、连接(connect)等动作。
scenario_en: In e-commerce/jobs/social search, beyond clicks there are actions like add-to-cart, apply, and connect.
q: 为什么 add-to-cart / apply / connect 比单纯点击是更强的正例信号?
q_en: Why are add-to-cart / apply / connect stronger positive signals than a plain click?
why: 加购/投递/连接是用户主动投入成本的动作,意图强、噪声低——比一次可能是误点的 click 更能证明 query-doc 相关。代价:量比点击少(中等规模),而且是平台专属信号,不通用。
why_en: Add-to-cart, apply, and connect are actions where the user invests effort, so intent is strong and noise low, proving relevance better than a possibly accidental click.
options: 因为它们的数据量比点击更大,海量所以更可靠、更适合当训练主信号
因为它们能自动纠正 position bias,而普通点击做不到这一点
因为它们代表更强的用户意图、噪声低,比「点了但可能误点」更能证明相关
因为它们不需要 dwell 过滤,天生就是显式人工标注级别的信号
options_en: Because their data volume is larger than clicks, so being abundant they are more reliable as the primary signal.
Because they automatically correct position bias, which ordinary clicks cannot.
Because they represent stronger user intent with low noise, proving relevance better than a possibly accidental click.
Because they need no dwell filtering and are natively as clean as explicit human labels.
optionExplanations: 恰恰相反,这类动作量比点击少(中等规模),强在意图而非数量。
纠 position bias 是 IPW 的活,和动作信号是两回事,不能混为一谈。
对;用户愿意加购/投递说明真的相关,噪声远低于一次可能手滑的点击。
它们仍是隐式信号、不是人工标注,只是意图更强,不能免去质控。
optionExplanations_en: On the contrary, these actions are fewer than clicks (medium volume); their strength is intent, not quantity.
Correcting position bias is IPW's job, a separate matter from action signals.
Correct — a user bothering to add-to-cart or apply signals genuine relevance, far less noisy than a possibly slipped click.
They are still implicit signals, not human labels; stronger intent does not remove the need for QC.

termDefinitions.meaning: 加购、投递、连接等高投入动作,意图强、噪声低的平台专属正例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An action signal is a high-effort action (add-to-cart, apply, connect), a low-noise, platform-specific positive.

scenario: 除了隐式信号,还可以雇人工评审员给 (query, doc) 对打相关性分,如 0-4 五档。
scenario_en: Beyond implicit signals, human raters can grade (query, doc) pairs on a 0-4 scale.
q: 显式人工相关性标注(如 0-4 分)在数据策略里扮演什么角色?
q_en: What role do explicit human relevance labels (e.g. 0-4) play in the data strategy?
why: 人工 0-4 分噪声极低(gold standard)但很贵、量少,所以不当训练主力,而是拿来做离线评估、校准 NDCG 这类需要可信基准的指标。隐式信号负责规模训练,显式标注负责可信评估。
why_en: Human 0-4 labels are very low-noise (gold standard) but costly and scarce, so they serve offline evaluation and NDCG calibration rather than bulk training.
options: 是模型的主要训练信号,靠这批海量标注直接训练双塔编码器上线
用来在线上实时纠正 position bias 和曝光偏差,替代 IPW 加权
完全替代点击日志,有了人工分就不再需要任何隐式信号做训练
干净但稀缺的 gold standard,主要用于离线评估、校准 NDCG
options_en: The model's primary training signal — train the dual-encoder directly on this abundant labeled set.
Used to correct position bias and exposure bias live online, replacing IPW.
A full replacement for click logs — with human labels you no longer need any implicit signal for training.
A clean but scarce gold standard, used mainly for offline evaluation and NDCG calibration.
optionExplanations: 人工标注太贵太少,覆盖不了长尾 query,当训练主力规模根本不够。
纠 position bias 靠 IPW,不是靠人工分;而且人工标注是离线的,做不了实时纠偏。
隐式信号才有规模,显式标注替代不了训练量,两者是分工不是替代。
对;0-4 分最干净,拿来当可信基准做离线评估、校准 NDCG,而不是喂大规模训练。
optionExplanations_en: Human labels are too costly and few to cover long-tail queries, nowhere near enough scale to be the primary trainer.
Position bias is corrected by IPW, not human labels, which are offline and cannot correct live.
Implicit signals provide the scale; explicit labels cannot replace training volume — they divide labor, not substitute.
Correct — 0-4 labels are cleanest, used as a trusted baseline for offline eval and NDCG calibration, not bulk training.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被当作最可信参考的标注,这里指人工分级相关性,用于评估。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A gold standard is the most trusted reference labels, here human graded relevance used for evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 归一化折损累计增益:按位置折扣累计相关性收益、再归一化的排序质量指标,需要分级标注。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG (Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain) is a ranking metric that discounts relevance gain by rank and normalizes it, requiring graded labels.

scenario: 隐式信号(点击/停留)海量但噪声大;显式人工标注干净但稀缺又贵。你要给两者分工。
scenario_en: Implicit signals (clicks/dwell) are abundant but noisy; explicit labels are clean but scarce and costly. You must divide their roles.
q: 隐式信号和显式标注该各自用在哪里?
q_en: Where should implicit signals and explicit labels each be used?
why: 隐式信号量大够喂训练但含 position bias 等噪声;显式标注干净但太少,拿去训练覆盖不了长尾。所以规模训练用隐式、可信评估用显式,各取所长。
why_en: Implicit signals are big enough to train but carry noise like position bias; explicit labels are clean but too few to train the long tail, so train on implicit and evaluate on explicit.
tradeoff: 隐式训练 + 显式评估(规模与可信兼得) vs 单一来源(要么噪声大要么量不够)
whenOtherWins: 如果隐式点击严重不可信(冷启动、恶意刷量)而预算充足,可以更多依赖显式标注,甚至用它做小规模训练。
options: 全用显式标注,又干净又权威,隐式信号噪声大应该彻底弃用不再采集
隐式信号做大规模训练,显式标注做离线评估——用规模喂训练、用干净保评估
全用隐式信号,人工标注太贵一律不做,评估也用点击率代替就行
两者混在一起当同一批训练数据,不区分噪声和用途直接一起喂进去
options_en: Use only explicit labels — clean and authoritative — and drop noisy implicit signals entirely.
Implicit signals for large-scale training, explicit labels for offline evaluation — scale for training, cleanliness for eval.
Use only implicit signals — human labeling is too costly, so replace evaluation with click rate too.
Mix both into one training set without distinguishing noise or purpose, feeding them together.
optionExplanations: 只用显式标注量太小,训练覆盖不了长尾,规模上根本喂不动大模型。
对;隐式给规模、显式给可信基准,这正是「训练用隐式、评估用显式」的标准分工。
没有显式基准,评估就没有可信锚点,点击率本身带 position bias 不能当真值。
混着喂等于把高噪声隐式和干净显式搅在一起,既污染训练又浪费宝贵的干净标签。
optionExplanations_en: Only explicit labels are too few; training cannot cover the long tail and cannot feed a large model at scale.
Correct — implicit gives scale, explicit gives a trusted baseline, the standard split of train-on-implicit, eval-on-explicit.
Without an explicit baseline, evaluation has no trusted anchor, and click rate itself carries position bias and is not ground truth.
Mixing pours noisy implicit and clean explicit together, polluting training and wasting the scarce clean labels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从用户行为(点击、停留)间接推出的相关性,海量但含噪声。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An implicit signal infers relevance indirectly from user behavior (clicks, dwell), abundant but noisy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上线前用固定测试集和可信标注衡量模型质量,常用 NDCG、recall@K。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Offline evaluation measures model quality before launch on a fixed test set with trusted labels, using metrics like NDCG and recall@K.
